examples.scenario: Parcel point is mapped to pixel corner instead of center.
examples.reason: Use native affine transform; first pixel center is offset by 0.5,0.5.

examples.scenario: PixelIsPoint GeoTIFF is treated as PixelIsArea.
examples.reason: AREA_OR_POINT semantics must be recorded and half-pixel drift prevented.

examples.scenario: PixelIsArea file is shifted by an extra half pixel.
examples.reason: Do not apply an invented correction on top of GDAL interpretation.

examples.scenario: XY→row/col returns adjacent cell after floating rounding.
examples.reason: Forward/inverse addressing must return the same native cell under the project policy.

examples.scenario: Two adjacent tiles both own the shared edge cell.
examples.reason: Apply one serialized project half-open seam ownership rule.

examples.scenario: Neither adjacent tile owns the shared edge.
examples.reason: Coverage union must have no gap at tile seams.

examples.scenario: Project seam rule is described as a GDAL guarantee.
examples.reason: Keep project-defined ownership policy separate from library behavior.

examples.scenario: Rightmost partial block scans padding bytes as elevations.
examples.reason: Use actual valid block dimensions.

examples.scenario: Bottom partial block assumes full block height.
examples.reason: GetActualBlockSize/explicit valid dimensions gate the scan.

examples.scenario: ReadBlock buffer padding happens to contain a low value.
examples.reason: Undefined bytes outside raster extent never enter extrema.

examples.scenario: RasterIO downsamples a window while computing extrema.
examples.reason: Terminal scan must use native source dimensions.

examples.scenario: RasterIO buffer type narrows Float64 to Float32.
examples.reason: Preserve native datatype for exact comparison.

examples.scenario: Overview is automatically chosen for a large read.
examples.reason: Exact extrema require full-resolution native cells.

examples.scenario: Mask=0 pixel has an extreme numeric value.
examples.reason: Validity precedes numeric comparison.

examples.scenario: NoData sentinel is valid-looking after type conversion.
examples.reason: Typed nodata comparison is required.

examples.scenario: Alpha=0 source overrides a valid lower-priority tile in a VRT overlap.
examples.reason: Overlap contributor/mask semantics must be explicit.

examples.scenario: GTI overlap order changes between runs.
examples.reason: Pin sort field/direction and source identities.

examples.scenario: VRT source list order changes and extrema changes.
examples.reason: Source priority is provenance.

examples.scenario: VRT srcwin clips one row from a tile.
examples.reason: Freeze and read back source/destination windows.

examples.scenario: VRT uses bilinear resampling.
examples.reason: Terminal exact extrema cannot use interpolated cells.

examples.scenario: Mosaic uncovered area becomes numeric zero.
examples.reason: Require nodata/alpha coverage semantics.

examples.scenario: True terrain minimum near zero is confused with uncovered mosaic zero.
examples.reason: Validity mask must distinguish data from background.

examples.scenario: Target-aligned-pixels rounds extent and silently changes terminal domain.
examples.reason: Alignment choice and resulting grid must be serialized.

examples.scenario: Rasterized parcel mask uses a different resolution than elevation raster.
examples.reason: Mask and elevation grid identity must match.

examples.scenario: Bounding-box clip includes cells outside parcel polygon.
examples.reason: Geometry membership, not bbox alone, defines terminal domain.

examples.scenario: Window extends outside source and zero-filled cells enter scan.
examples.reason: Use fail-closed outside-window policy.

examples.scenario: Tile footprint intersects parcel but valid-pixel footprint does not.
examples.reason: Check actual valid-data footprint.

examples.scenario: clean-collar-derived mask is accepted as original source validity.
examples.reason: Derived edge cleaning cannot silently redefine canonical raster.

examples.scenario: fill-nodata creates a new local maximum.
examples.reason: Interpolated nodata fill is QA/derivative only.

examples.scenario: Reprojected raster has a different maximum.
examples.reason: Use native raster for terminal extrema and transformations only as controlled derivatives.

examples.scenario: gdal raster as-features center disagrees with manual affine formula.
examples.reason: Independent pixel-center audit must agree.

examples.scenario: pixel-info reports a different VRT contributor than expected.
examples.reason: Terminal source contributor must be reconciled.

examples.scenario: Golden compare skips geotransform and pixels match.
examples.reason: Pixel equality alone does not prove same cell locations.

examples.scenario: Golden compare skips CRS and metadata.
examples.reason: CRS/geotransform/metadata are part of terminal equivalence.

examples.scenario: Converted GeoTIFF has matching visible pixels but different nodata mask.
examples.reason: Validity metadata must match too.

examples.scenario: Tile index footprint path points to a changed raster.
examples.reason: Pin raster digest in addition to index path.

examples.scenario: GTI infers datatype/resolution from an arbitrary first tile.
examples.reason: Pin dataset datatype, extent and resolution.

examples.scenario: Runtime cache is changed and numeric result differs.
examples.reason: Record runtime config and require identical terminal result.

examples.scenario: Concurrent calls use the same GDAL dataset object unsafely.
examples.reason: Do not assume RasterBand methods are thread-safe on one dataset instance.

examples.scenario: Web map tiles are used as elevation source cells.
examples.reason: Publication/resampled tiles are visualization only.

examples.scenario: Approximate statistics match exact scan and are accepted as proof.
examples.reason: Agreement does not convert approximate statistics into exact evidence.

examples.scenario: Seam cell is counted once but from the wrong overlapping source.
examples.reason: Single ownership and correct source provenance are both required.

examples.scenario: Source-chain readiness 99.99 is reported as measured elevation accuracy.
examples.reason: Preparation confidence is not target measurement accuracy.

examples.scenario: Height difference is published before canonical point/boundary/native seam scan exists.
examples.reason: Real numeric/business output remains fail-closed.
